category_title: Students with limited expressive language who use visual supports and exhibit avoidance behaviors
scenario_title: Transitioning to structured one-on-one math tasks
minimal_context: Evan is being asked to transition to a one-on-one work area to complete two-digit addition and subtraction problems.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Evan, it is time for our 30-minute work time. Let's move to the work area to write the answers to your five addition and five subtraction problems.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Evan does not follow the direction. He stands in place, flipping a straw back and forth in front of his eyes.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Evan, please put the straw down and come over to the table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Evan drops to the floor and lies down instead of moving to the structured task area.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to get up now so we can finish your math work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Evan crawls under the table to avoid the work. When approached, he protests the activity by kicking at the adult.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Evan, it is time for our 30-minute work time. Let's move to the work area to write the answers to your five addition and five subtraction problems.

STUDENT: (Evan does not follow the direction. He stands in place, flipping a straw back and forth in front of his eyes.)

TUTOR: Evan, please put the straw down and come over to the table.

STUDENT: (Evan drops to the floor and lies down instead of moving to the structured task area.)

TUTOR: You need to get up now so we can finish your math work.

STUDENT: (Evan crawls under the table to avoid the work. When approached, he protests the activity by kicking at the adult.)

task.content: Writing the answer to five addition and five subtraction problems with two-digit numerals

context.environment: area to work on structured tasks
context.materials: visual schedule that identified activities of the day and the reinforcers, straw
context.social_setting: one-on-one work with an assigned educator

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when asked to transition or move to an area to work on structured tasks
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: tended to lie on the floor or crawl under a table

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: running away, and kicking and hitting adults
engaged in self-stimulatory behavior, especially flipping a straw back and forth in front of his eyes
